tests.name: Onboarding - Goal
tests.message: Database schema mismatch - Render database expects 384 dimensions but OpenAI text-embedding-3-large returns 3072 dimensions

blocking_issue.description: Render database has 384-dimension vector columns, but code is using text-embedding-3-large (3072 dimensions)
blocking_issue.solution:
1. Deploy code changes (switches to text-embedding-3-small)
2. Run migration on Render database
3. Set OPENAI_EMBED_MODEL=text-embedding-3-small in Render environment
